name: eyebox
description: EyeBox — free self-hosted YouTube-like platform with full auth and E2E encryption

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix web"
